mapper.select: SELECT p.subject_type AS "subjectType", p.subject_id AS "subjectId", p.permission_type AS "permissionType" FROM bt_dc_document_permission p WHERE p.status_cd = '00A' AND p.document_id = #{documentId} AND p.granted_by = #{userId}

SELECT p.subject_id AS "itemId", p.permission_type AS "permission", p.subject_type AS "type", CONCAT('', p.subject_id) AS "itemName" FROM bt_dc_document_permission p WHERE p.status_cd = '00A' AND p.document_id = #{documentId} AND p.granted_by = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_time DESC
